contract: Identical recursive source algorithms, optimized runtime archive, Clang flags and input depth 14/seed 17. Baseline/current and unbound/bound-token cells are interleaved across three fresh processes and five measured plus two warmup batches. Binding, invocation lifecycle, arithmetic checks, logical admission and cancellation acquire loads remain enabled. All checksums must match independent Fraction/integer/GCD references exactly. This isolates a compiler change; it is not a cross-language ranking or GPU benchmark. Observed cells bind an atomic diagnostic poll counter; allocation/binding/reset are included and the ordinary observed execution path remains enabled.
